description: The queries worth working on THIS week: everything ranking just off page one, ranked by how much traffic a realistic move would unlock. Returns each query with its position, impressions, the page that ranks for it, and a `priority` score (impressions weighted by how close to page one it already is — a ranking heuristic for ordering the list, NOT a traffic forecast). Position 11-60 by default: above 11 is already page one, below 60 is rarely reachable without new authority. This is the report to open before deciding what to write or rewrite — it is the difference between improving a page that can move and rewriting one that cannot. Requires a paid plan (Starter+).

domain.description: Bare domain, e.g. 'example.com'. Provide this OR siteUrl.

maxPosition.description: Upper bound. Default 60 — past this, position is an authority problem, not a content one.

minImpressions.description: Ignore queries below this many impressions. Default 1.

minPosition.description: Lower bound of the band. Default 11 (just off page one).

name: gsc_striking_distance
